_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and change only what you need. Any key you leave out uses the default.
_machine_name: Shown in the machine column so you can see who entered each bill. Set a different one on each computer. Blank = the Windows computer name.
_columns: Sheet column for each value. Use "" to not write that value. Header row 1 is never written.
_timestamp_format: "auto" copies the style already in the BILL ENTRY timestamp column (time only in the current sheet). Or "time" / "datetime".
